deck_title: Welford online centered FP32 variance vs naive E[X^2]-E[X]^2 catastrophic cancellation rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic B. P. Welford (Technometrics 1962) & Donald Knuth (TAOCP Vol. 2) single-pass online centered variance update in IEEE-754 float32 (delta1 = x_n - mu_{n-1}, mu_n = mu_{n-1} + delta1/n, delta2 = x_n - mu_n, M2 += delta1*delta2, locking normalized variance V = 1.0000x) versus naive textbook uncentered sum-of-squares (E[X^2] - E[X]^2 in float32, which suffers catastrophic mantissa cancellation for HDR base luminance B >= 2400 nits) and 64-sample two-pass Kahan FP64 reference across 17 HDR luminance stations (B in [0, 6400] nits, signal fluctuation +/-0.50).
